verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe a terminal view where you can watch commands run and see output logs, plus an Interactive Browser you can join. That gives developers live visibility into what the running agent is doing. Nothing in the evidence documents an explicit current-status indicator or a session progress view, and nothing independent confirms the live view works as described. missing for 10: documented real-time session status/state indicator, progress or step timeline view, independent or hands-on corroboration of live monitoring.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Devin’s terminal, where you can watch commands being executed and view output logs.
You can jump in to help Devin navigate through browsing tasks via the Interactive Browser.
